sources.section: 3.9.2 Metallic-Roughness Material; 5.22 Material PBR Metallic Roughness (baseColorTexture, metallicRoughnessTexture)
sources.facts: Base colour: RGB encoded with the sRGB transfer function; the fourth component (A), when present, is the linear alpha coverage. Metallic-roughness: metalness sampled from B, roughness from G, linear transfer function; R and A are ignored for metallic-roughness calculations.

sources.section: 3.9.3 Additional Textures (Normal Texture, Occlusion Texture); 5.19 Material (normalTexture, occlusionTexture, emissiveTexture)
sources.facts: Normal: tangent-space XYZ as RGB with the linear transfer function, the convention +X right and +Y up, +Z toward the viewer, A ignored. Occlusion: linearly sampled from R, higher values receive full indirect lighting, G, B and A ignored. Emissive: RGB encoded with the sRGB transfer function, A ignored.
The alpha value of the metallic-roughness material model is taken from the fourth component of the base colour.

sources.section: 2.6 File Extensions and Media Types; 3.8.3 Images
sources.facts: Core images are image/png or image/jpeg; JPEG has one or three 8-bit components (no alpha); colour-space information in PNG or JPEG files is ignored, so the transfer function is the one the referring glTF property defines.
SpecularWeight is exported and reported in the export receipt as a consumer gap wherever the consumer has no binding for it; omitting it silently was rejected.

packing.decision: RGB from documentMap basecolor, A from documentMap opacity (dropped when the stack has no opacity channel, probe P7); the colour is written in its channel's encoding (an sRGB8 BaseColor sRGB-encoded, decision 126)
packing.source: glTF 2.0 §3.9.2 and §5.22 baseColorTexture (sRGB RGB, linear alpha coverage in A); §3.9.4 Alpha Coverage

packing.decision: R from defaultMap white, G from documentMap roughness, B from documentMap metallic, linear
packing.source: glTF 2.0 §3.9.2 and §5.22 metallicRoughnessTexture (roughness in G, metalness in B, linear, R and A ignored); R holds 1.0, full indirect lighting, so a consumer that also binds this texture as occlusion (R, §5.19 occlusionTexture) sees none (decision 314)
glTF 2.0 §3.9.3 Normal Texture and §5.19 normalTexture (tangent space, +X right and +Y up: the OpenGL convention; linear)

packing.decision: L from virtualMap AO_Mixed (the AO mesh map combined with the AO channel), linear; refused until AO_Mixed is fitted (decision 131)
packing.source: glTF 2.0 §3.9.3 Occlusion Texture and §5.19 occlusionTexture (R sampled linearly; a greyscale PNG decodes to R = G = B = L); the source map: decision 314

packing.decision: RGB from documentMap emissive, written in its channel's encoding
L from documentMap specularweight, written when the stack has the channel; the receipt reports it as a consumer gap
packing.source: decision 023; glTF 2.0 §3.9.2 (the core metallic-roughness material has no specular input); decision 314

packing.decision: Files named $textureSet_<glTF texture>, each with fileFormat png and no other parameter: bit depth, padding and dithering come from exportParameters until the recording shows what the preset itself sets; no Height map (no glTF core slot)
packing.source: glTF 2.0 §2.6 and §3.8.3 (PNG or JPEG; JPEG has no alpha and is lossy); decision 314
